name.description: Name attribute shared by all radios of the group. Required.

value.description: Value submitted when this radio is checked.

checked.description: Checked state of the radio. Forwarded to the control.

disabled.description: Disabled attribute of the radio. Forwarded to the control.

aria-describedby.description: Id of the feedback element of the surrounding group. Sw:Form:RadioGroup passes its own. Forwarded to the control.

validationRules.description: Comma separated list of client-side validation rules, rendered as data-validation.

required.description: Renders aria-required. The required marker belongs to the legend of the group.

isInvalid.description: Marks the control invalid. Sw:Form:RadioGroup passes its own state down.

additionalInputClass.description: Additional classes on the radio. `class` on the component tag dresses the wrapper instead.
